summary: Genuine: tests assert exact-key properties dict (area+failure_kind only), PiOperationArea.allCases matches the 4 required raw values exactly, and classifyHandledFailure is proven via near-boundary counterexamples (processExited, non-ClientError NSError) to never yield the sibling-only process_lifecycle/launch_failed kinds, only {request_timed_out,invalid_response,write_failed,unknown}.
